title: Pace Incentive Table for the Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Spend-Milestone Bonus
content:
**Table note.** The milestone pace of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is the number of whole calendar months the current agreement year has run at the credit date, counted from the latest anniversary of the approval date; an agreement year runs 12 months. The milestone pace adds a pace uplift to the spend-milestone bonus:

| Milestone pace at the credit date | Pace uplift |
|---|---|
| 8 whole months or fewer | 40 percentage points |
| more than 8 and no more than 10 whole months | 15 percentage points |
| more than 10 whole months | nothing |

**How the uplift acts.** The uplift is counted in percentage points; milestone uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the milestone bonus is raised by the total: the milestone bonus before its allowance is the milestone bonus multiplied by one hundred plus the total uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point.

### Cases (hypothetical, agreement approved on 1 March)

| Credit date | Latest anniversary | Pace | Pace uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 October | 1 March of the same year | 7 months | 40 percentage points |
| 1 November | 1 March of the same year | 8 months | 40 percentage points |
| 1 December | 1 March of the same year | 9 months | 15 percentage points |
| 1 February | 1 March of the previous year | 11 months | nothing |

A milestone bonus of 5000 points with a pace uplift of 40 percentage points and no other uplift becomes 5000 multiplied by 140 and divided by one hundred: 7000 points before its allowance.
